The bytes in field.bin are 01 followed by 61 zeros. This is no problem. When they are not immediately followed by a 1 in /world, they are not worth debugging. The 01 followed by 61 is not part of any literal bytes; it is just a sign. The pattern of bytes between 01 followed by 61 is a shorthand convention. It is used to conveniently write out in bytes the contents of field.bin.

If you want to "edit" a byte, simply create a 01 followed by 61. Similarly, if you want to "reset" a byte, simply create a 01 followed by 61. The pattern of bytes between 01 followed by 61 is a shorthand convention. It is used to conveniently write out in bytes the contents of field.bin.
